pairingModel.candidateGeneration: Within each (chunkId, temporalPassId, poseSectionId) group, eligible supported runs ranked by mean route-d (left-to-right). Adjacent run pairs in lateral order are pairing candidates when route-s ranges overlap.

routeSOverlapM.description: Shared route-s span between left and right divider runs

laneWidthM.description: Left d minus right d at sampled s (positive when left divider has higher d)

widthStdM.description: Standard deviation of width samples along overlap

meanConfidence.description: Mean lane-line probability of supporting observations

meanUncertaintyM.description: Mean lane-line std of supporting observations

pairingModel.gating: Reject when overlap too short, intervening divider present, non-positive width, width outlier, unstable width, boundary mismatch, low confidence, high uncertainty, or ambiguous observation geometry
pairingModel.tieBreaking: Deterministic ordering by dividerRunId when mean d values tie within lateralOrderToleranceM
pairingModel.adjacency: Only immediately adjacent runs in lateral ranking may form an interval; local route-s sampling verifies adjacency across the shared span
pairingModel.signedWidthConvention: widthM = leftRouteD - rightRouteD where left is the higher mean route-d boundary

countingSemantics.observedDividerRuns: Stage 17 supported runs with finite route-d geometry
countingSemantics.evidenceSupportedLaneIntervals: Drivable lateral space between two adjacent compatible divider runs with overlapping route-s support
countingSemantics.assessedSameDirectionLanes: Supported same-direction interval count derived only from adjacent accepted intervals in an assessed route-s span; not total physical road lanes
countingSemantics.unknownOrUnsupportedNeighbouringSpace: Missing outer boundary or Stage 17 gap — not counted as zero lanes
countingSemantics.shouldersAndNonDriving: Not classified without explicit divider evidence

widthComparisonToleranceM.purpose: Floating-point slack for prototype band and threshold comparisons only

widthPositiveToleranceM.purpose: Strict floor for signed positivity; must not legitimise genuinely non-positive widths

comparisonsUsingPositiveTolerance: per-sample width validity before interval acceptance
widthTolerancePolicy.nearZeroTreatment: Widths with value <= WIDTH_POSITIVE_EPS_M are non-positive. Widths in (WIDTH_POSITIVE_EPS_M, WIDTH_COMPARISON_EPS_M] remain positive but may still fail narrow prototype gates.

thresholdExamples.1.9999999999999998: Treat as >= 2.0 m for narrow/minPrototype gates (within comparison tolerance)
thresholdExamples.2.0000000000000004: Treat as >= 2.0 m for narrow/minPrototype gates
thresholdExamples.5.499999999999999: Treat as <= 5.5 m for wide/maxPrototype gates
thresholdExamples.5.500000000000001: Treat as <= 5.5 m for wide/maxPrototype gates

widthTolerancePolicy.nanAndInfiniteTreatment: NaN and ±Infinity widths are invalid samples; they increment nonPositiveCount and invalidate finiteSampleRate.
widthTolerancePolicy.signedWidthConvention: leftRouteD - rightRouteD with left assigned as the higher mean-d boundary within the pair

signedWidthConvention: leftRouteD - rightRouteD with left assigned as the higher mean-d boundary within the pair

pairingOutcomeReconciliation.legacyRejectedNonPositiveWidthNote: The pre-review aggregate rejected_non_positive_width count (704) is superseded by local-adjacency and crossing classifications. Current legacy aggregate is 0; see widthOrderFailureInvestigation.

widthOrderFailureInvestigation.note: After local route-s adjacency gating, former rejected_non_positive_width cases are redistributed across rejected_non_adjacent, rejected_crossing, rejected_boundary, and rejected_non_positive_width.
